scope: Independent original-size inspection of exactly 32 P-source AVI-derived PNG samples and independent payload/source-receipt/decode audit of two actual native default-v14 high_return movies. Acceptance covers evidence integrity, sampled initial takeoff framing, sampled long-climb/landing visibility and visible local fruit attachments. It does not certify continuous motion comfort, full forest art, full gameplay acceptance or current remote CI.

method.pixel_viewing: All 32 listed original 1280x720 PNGs were opened with view_image(detail=original), four batches of eight. No resize/crop/recolor/paintover was used.
method.audit: Full SHA256 reread of both AVIs, both MP4s, all 32 PNGs and bound receipts; fresh ffprobe of four videos; two independent ffmpeg select decodes to RGB24 compared byte-for-byte with each PNG. No native game, browser, CI or replay process was launched.
method.independence: Read-only reviewer did not implement or alter reviewed production code. Only ignored review outputs were created.
method.timing: All movie times are zero-based AVI frame index / 60. Physics tick is separate. First jump samples -1,0,+8 relative to presentation_frame=32 are not three consecutive frames.

observations.finding: The entry platform, vertical trunks and hanging fruit retain their same screen locations while the character leaves the platform and rises toward the first fruit. Character silhouette, takeoff effect and hook remain visible. This finite initial takeoff sample shows no whole-scene composition switch.
observations.limit: This is the initial part of an air-chain ascent, not a standalone short-jump fixture or a continuous smoothness measurement.

observations.finding: Successive long-climb samples show changed framing of branches/platforms while the character and current hook fruit stay in the central visible play area. The sampled climb is not presented through a permanently locked camera. Receive platforms and overhead branch silhouettes are visible in these windows.
observations.limit: Sparse samples cannot establish frame-to-frame camera velocity, continuous motion comfort or parallax behavior.

observations.finding: At the relay fruit the hook and body are readable against dark open space. Later samples show the character above, then supported on, a clearly outlined horizontal crown landing. A hanging side fruit remains visibly separate from the landing edge.
observations.limit: Arrival identity comes from the bound original event; these are not consecutive frames or proof of every landing.

observations.finding: Visible long curved/angled wood branches continue from side trunks/platform edges and carry short downward fruit stems. Leaf clusters reinforce their direction while leaving open body space. This reads more credibly as fruit hanging from a plant structure than an isolated marker on a thin pole rising from a foot platform. Amber fruit, muted olive fruit and pale cyan paired-seed fruit have distinct visible treatments.
observations.limit: Role-to-color correctness and player discovery priority cannot be proven from pixels alone; route-binding metadata and contract results remain separate. These images do not cover every v14 fruit or the entire deep-basin composition.

observations.finding: Sampled enemies, threat surfaces and player silhouette remain identifiable. The map1 root-camp final frame and map2 north-camp final frame place the player on a visible broad support. Map2 shows the crossbranch enemy as a real grapple target, distinct from fruit.
observations.limit: Combat completion is supported by native capture/receipt, not inferred from static attack poses. No Boss fight is shown.

retained_findings.evidence: Both initial frames have fruit clipped by the top edge; the opaque top-left HUD covers trunk/background and map2 image016 partially covers a top-left fruit. Right-side menu/appearance controls overlap edge content, including fruit/branch regions in several samples.
retained_findings.judgment: Do not report universal HUD-safe target coverage. None of these 32 samples establishes that an opaque control hides the currently used player or target, but edge visibility still needs broader camera/UI review.

retained_findings.evidence: Flat rectangular terrain and large repeated low-detail trunk silhouettes dominate the samples, alongside a more detailed character sprite.
retained_findings.judgment: Local attachments are legible; this is not whole-forest visual completion or commercial art approval.

retained_findings.evidence: Both native captures explicitly set boss_fight_covered=false.
retained_findings.judgment: Boss framing, combat readability and arena coverage remain unverified.

raw_storage_caveat.note: Exact-byte duplicate AVI payloads were hardlinked after executions/derivatives/guards completed. Source-specific execution receipts and captures remain distinct; no result is rebound from older source. Shared inode mtimes are unified and cannot prove fresh execution. Original P execution UTC/source guards are in original wrapper; helper first failed an incorrect mtime assertion and that failure remains in dedup audit.
